verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM. Admins can see each device's security posture and enforce security settings from the compliance dashboard, and there is a one-click secure baseline for macOS and Windows, so device-level compliance tracking is a documented first-party capability. The evidence never names the specific checks in the story or shows that devices map to employees. Missing for 10: explicit disk encryption, screen lock and password manager checks, per-employee compliance attribution or reporting, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration

citations.quote: Admins can confirm that devices are managed, see each device’s security posture, enforce security settings
Oneleet MDM lets your team manage company-owned devices from the same dashboard as the rest of your security and compliance program.
Oneleet offers a recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows that can be applied in one click.
